Record Class CardSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.it.observer.CardSnapshot
Record Components:
id - card identifier from the card database
era - era printed on the card
type - broad card category
characterType - character role, or null for non-character cards
foodCost - building food cost; 0 for non-building cards
finalPoints - building final points; 0 for non-building cards
effectDescription - effect text or event type name, depending on card type
details - character-specific printed data, or null
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record CardSnapshot(int id, Era era, CardSnapshot.Type type, CharacterType characterType, int foodCost, int finalPoints, String effectDescription, CardSnapshot.CharacterDetails details) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable snapshot of a card, carried by GameEvents and sent over the network.

Implements Serializable so it can be passed inside Message objects over RMI and via Java object serialisation over sockets.

The details field carries character-specific data that is critical to the player's decision (number of star icons for Shamans, trigger flag for Hunters, invention identifier for Inventors, discount and end-game points for Builders). It is null for non-character cards. Keeping these fields separate avoids inflating the main record with optional values.
